title: Console host integration files
responsibility: Produces SvelteKit server modules and routes that connect the console to a host policy and bundled or private-bucket history.

inputs.name: consoleHostFiles.options
inputs.description: Console base route, policy module and export name, and optionally a bucket binding and prefix. These values are inserted into generated source and should already be validated by the caller.

outputs.name: consoleHostFiles
outputs.description: Six path/content entries: server module, root and catch-all document routes, and JSON, export and media endpoints. All endpoints use protected console access; no filesystem writes occur here.
